# CLI reference

`relaybay [--version] <command> [options]`; without a command, `serve` runs.
`python -m relaybay` is the same. `relaybay <command> --help` prints the same options.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`serve`](#serve) | Start the server (default command). |
| [`token`](#token) | Print the access token and how to connect Claude Code. |
| [`setup`](#setup) | Connect Claude Code on this machine: hooks in user settings, MCP check. |
| [`doctor`](#doctor) | Diagnose the installation: versions, data folder, server, Claude Code. |
| [`demo`](#demo) | Seed a demo workspace (acme-shop, demo-api) into a data directory. |
| [`import`](#import) | Bring a markdown setup (project briefs, task registry, task notes, memory notes) into relaybay. Prints the plan; writes nothing without --apply. |
| [`export`](#export) | Write documents, decisions, notes and the task registry back to the markdown layout. Prints what would change; writes nothing without --apply. |
| [`desktop`](#desktop) | Start the desktop program: tray icon, board window and the server (needs relaybay[desktop]); 'desktop config' shows or changes its settings. |
| [`hook`](#hook) | Forward one hook event from stdin (command hook). |

## `serve`

Start the server (default command).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--host` | `HOST` | Bind address (default 127.0.0.1). |
| `--port` | `PORT` | Port (default 8765). |
| `--home` | `HOME` | Data directory (default: per-user data dir). |
| `--reload` |  | Restart on code changes (dev). |
| `--claude-home` | `CLAUDE_HOME` | Folder holding Claude Code's .claude/ and .claude.json for the Integrations page (default: your home directory). |

## `token`

Print the access token and how to connect Claude Code.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--home` | `HOME` | Data directory. |
| `--rotate` |  | Generate a new token. |

## `setup`

Connect Claude Code on this machine: hooks in user settings, MCP check.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` |  | Print the plan, the diff and its hash; write nothing (default; with --remove: preview the removal). |
| `--apply` |  | Write the plan (with a backup). |
| `--remove` |  | Remove relaybay's hooks (with a backup). |
| `--check` |  | Check the setup end to end. |
| `--expect` | `HASH` | With --apply/--remove: write only if the plan still has this hash (printed by the dry run). Without it, the check covers only changes made during this run. |
| `--json` |  | With --check: print the results as JSON. |
| `--home` | `HOME` | relaybay data directory. |
| `--port` | `PORT` | relaybay port (default 8765). |
| `--claude-home` | `CLAUDE_HOME` | Folder holding .claude/settings.json and .claude.json (default: your home). |
| `--mode` | `command\|http` | Hook type: command (default; a small forwarder, silent when relaybay is down) or http (Claude Code posts itself; needs RELAYBAY_TOKEN in its environment). Default: `command`. |
| `--wake` |  | Also add the opt-in wake-up hook (command mode): an asyncRewake hook that wakes an idle session when an owner comment arrives (Claude Code 2.1.309 or later). |
| `--no-wake` |  | Remove the wake-up hook. |
| `--force-wake` |  | With --wake: install it although this Claude Code is older than 2.1.309 or its version is unknown (one that ignores asyncRewake would hold every turn's end). |

## `doctor`

Diagnose the installation: versions, data folder, server, Claude Code.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | Print the results as JSON. |
| `--home` | `HOME` | relaybay data directory. |
| `--port` | `PORT` | relaybay port (default 8765). |
| `--claude-home` | `CLAUDE_HOME` | Folder holding .claude/settings.json and .claude.json (default: your home). |

## `demo`

Seed a demo workspace (acme-shop, demo-api) into a data directory.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--home` | `HOME` | Data directory for the demo (required). Required. |
| `--force` |  | If the folder already holds a board, rename its database aside and start over. |

## `import`

Bring a markdown setup (project briefs, task registry, task notes, memory notes) into relaybay. Prints the plan; writes nothing without --apply.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `ROOT` | The folder holding the layout. Required. |
| `--apply` |  | Write the plan (default: a dry run, nothing written). |
| `--expect` | `HASH` | With --apply: write only if the plan still has this hash (printed by the dry run). Without it, you write whatever the plan is at that moment. |
| `--overwrite` |  | Take the file's text over a target changed on the board since its import (as a new version; old versions stay). |
| `--aliases` | `FILE` | JSON file with more column, stage and heading names, in any language. |
| `--retro-project` | `SLUG` | The project whose document 'retro' receives retro.md (skipped without it). |
| `--home` | `HOME` | relaybay data directory. |

## `export`

Write documents, decisions, notes and the task registry back to the markdown layout. Prints what would change; writes nothing without --apply.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `ROOT` | The folder to write to. Required. |
| `--apply` |  | Write the files (default: a dry run). |
| `--force` |  | Also overwrite or remove files changed by hand since the last export. |
| `--aliases` | `FILE` | The aliases of the import: a hand-written registry that says the same stays as it is. |
| `--home` | `HOME` | relaybay data directory. |

## `desktop`

Start the desktop program: tray icon, board window and the server (needs relaybay[desktop]); 'desktop config' shows or changes its settings.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--background` |  | Start with the window hidden, only the tray icon (the autostart entry uses it). |
| `--quit` |  | Ask the running program to quit (stops its server); exit 1 when none answers. |

### `desktop config`

Show desktop.toml (data folder, server, autostart) or change it with the options.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--home` | `HOME` | Data folder for the program and the CLI when neither --home nor RELAYBAY_HOME is given; '-' clears it. Moves nothing. |
| `--mode` | `embedded\|external` | Server mode. |
| `--url` | `URL` | Base URL of the external server ('-' clears it). |
| `--token-file` | `TOKEN_FILE` | File holding the external server's token; copied to external-token (0600) beside desktop.toml. |
| `--autostart` | `on\|off` | Start the program at login. |

## `hook`

Forward one hook event from stdin (command hook).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--home` | `HOME` | Data directory. |
| `--port` | `PORT` | Port (default 8765). |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | Success. |
| `1` | A failed setup write, a failed check item (`setup --check`, `doctor`), `demo` refused a data folder that already holds a board, or `import` / `export` has an item refused, in conflict or failed; `desktop --quit` found no running program, or a second `desktop` found one that holds the lock but does not answer. |
| `2` | Invalid settings or arguments; `desktop` without the `desktop` extra. |

`relaybay hook` always exits `0`, so a hook never fails a Claude Code session.
